comparison.objective: Load a caulking gun and lay a sealant bead; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Release-lever hold, plunger retraction, cartridge insertion, bimanual gun control, and path following versus hex-key unlocking, fine collar tuning, locking, and impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Cartridge seated, plunger engaged, at least 10 bead segments laid, and gun returned versus two repeatable safe stops. Candidate rebound/overload/drift thresholds are incomplete.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate adjustable mechanical controls, but the record tests tool loading and dispensing rather than closed-loop damping calibration.
